item.title: Presentation: Modernising Retail at Scale: Architecting a Cloud-to-Edge Platform for a Global Enterprise (Source: feed.infoq.com)
item.description: Jayesh Bhayani discusses Tesco's decade-long enterprise transformation from fragmented legacy systems to a unified cloud-edge platform. He explains how aligning system, talent, and process modernizations allowed Tesco to scale mission-critical retail operations to millions of customers, while sharing practical lessons on build vs. buy, cloud cost management, and preparing for agentic commerce. By Jayesh Bhayani

item.title: Presentation: AI-Assisted Software Delivery: From Code to Production (Source: feed.infoq.com)
item.description: The panelists explore how engineering teams adapt delivery architectures, pipelines, security, and governance for AI-assisted development. They share practical strategies for verifying AI-generated code, solving testing and deployment bottlenecks, maintaining human oversight, and measuring AI's true impact on software velocity, quality, reliability, and operational cost. By Garima Bajpaj, Martin Reynolds, Patrick Debois, Gunnar Grosch, Renato Losio

item.title: Article: Governed Autonomous Intelligence for Mission-Critical Utility (Source: feed.infoq.com)
item.description: The article describes an architecture for agentic AI in regulated utility operations. Agents reason and propose actions, but a deterministic policy gate and a governed tool gateway control execution, with human approval where required. It covers an AWS reference implementation, grounding in runbooks, governed prediction, outcome validation, audit evidence, and phased autonomy. By Purnang Borah

item.title: Presentation: Opening the Black Box: Critical Explainability for AI Agent Tool Selection with Kiji Inspector (Source: feed.infoq.com)
item.description: Hannes Hapke shares how Dataiku's open-source Kiji Inspector applies Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) directly to decision tokens to expose why agents pick specific tools. Moving past superficial chain-of-thought narratives, he discusses causal ablation, layer activation extraction via patched vLLM engines, and production monitoring workflows for software architects and senior engineering leaders. By Hannes Hapke
